name: readable
description: Styled replies and prompts: Markdown drawn with solid panels for code, quotes, prompts and pastes

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: terminal takes the colours of Rex's or Ghostty's current theme (embark elsewhere; ghostty is its old name); embark matches the Embark terminal theme; dark uses the colours of glamour's dark style.

sentencePerLine.title: One sentence per line
sentencePerLine.description: Start each sentence of a reply on a line of its own.

claudeTheme.title: Match Claude Code's theme to Rex
claudeTheme.description: Inside Rex, keep ~/.claude/themes/rex.json in step with Rex's theme (diff backgrounds, accents, status colours). Pick "Rex · …" in /theme once to use it.
